title: TipsGoalResult
description: tips.goal-result@1: one goal on OpenVibe.Tips (tips.goal.create, tips.goal.update, tips.goal.close). POST /api/v1/goals (201), PATCH /api/v1/goals/:id and POST /api/v1/goals/:id/close → { goal } (closing keeps its history; closing a closed goal changes nothing). GET /api/v1/goals/:id → { goal }: with contributions for the creator and granted services, else the public shape (404 tips.goal_not_found when the page is off).
